# FTIShowBasis

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIShowBasis`

Manual: [FTIShowBasis (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FTIShowBasis.md)

```text
FTIShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FTIShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    -x, --nbr-sitex : number of sites along the x direction (default value = 3)
    -y, --nbr-sitey : number of sites along the y direction (default value = 3)
    -z, --nbr-sitez : number of sites along the z direction (default value = 3)
    -t, --nbr-sitet : number of sites along the t direction (default value = 3)
    --kx : total momentum along the x direction (default value = 0)
    --ky : total momentum along the y direction (default value = 0)
    --kz : total momentum along the z direction (default value = 0)
    --kt : total momentum along the t direction (default value = 0)
    -s, --nbr-subbands : number of subbands (default value = 1)
    --3d : consider a 3d model instead of a 2d model
    --4d : consider a 4d model instead of a 2d model
    --spin-conserved : assume that the spin is conserved in the two band model
    --sz : twice the spin Sz value (only useful when --spin-conserved is on) (default value = 0)
    --open-y : only enforce momentum conservation x, treating ky as a coordinate along y
    --non-periodic : look at the non-periodic hilbert space with a cut in momentum space described by nbr-allowed-site and min-k
    -X, --nbr-allowed-sitex : number of x momenta allowed for a single particle (default value = 3)
    -Y, --nbr-allowed-sitey : number of y momenta allowed for a single particle (default value = 3)
    --min-kx : minimal x momentum allowed for a single particle (default value = 0)
    --min-ky : minimal y momentum allowed for a single particle (default value = 4)
    --min-kz : minimal z momentum allowed for a single particle (default value = 4)
    --min-kt : minimal t momentum allowed for a single particle (default value = 4)
    --allowed-orbitals : provide an ASCII file indicating which orbitals are allowed
    --max-band0 : maximum number of particles in band 0 (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --max-band1 : maximum number of particles in band 1 (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --max-band2 : maximum number of particles in band 2 (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --max-band3 : maximum number of particles in band 3 (negative if this number should be equal to the number of orbitals) (default value = -1)
    --min-band0 : minimum number of particles in band 0 (default value = 0)
    --min-band1 : minimum number of particles in band 1 (default value = 0)
    --min-band2 : minimum number of particles in band 2 (default value = 0)
    --min-band3 : minimum number of particles in band 3 (default value = 0)
    --wannier : use wannier wavefunction basis
    --state : name of an optional vector state whose component values can be displayed behind each corresponding n-body state
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)
    --no-autodetect : do not autdetect system parameter from state file name
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (not available for the non-periodic momentum space or the case with spin)

output options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
